definitions.explanation: Something said or done for amusement; not meant to be taken seriously.

examples.japanese: {冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}って{皆|みんな}を{笑|わら}わせた。
examples.english: I told a joke and made everyone laugh.

examples.japanese: {冗談|じょうだん}じゃないよ、{本当|ほんとう}だって。

notes:
{冗談|じょうだん} refers to jokes or kidding around.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}う (to tell a joke, to joke)
- {冗談|じょうだん}じゃない (I'm not joking; this is no joke)
- {冗談|じょうだん}にする (to make a joke of something)
- {冗談|じょうだん}が{通|つう}じない (unable to take a joke)
- {冗談|じょうだん}はよせ (stop joking; quit it)
- {冗談|じょうだん}{半分|はんぶん}に (half-jokingly)

REGISTER:
{冗談|じょうだん} is neutral and can be used in most situations. For more casual speech, ジョーク (from English "joke") is also common.

COMMON MISTAKE:
"{冗談|じょうだん}を{作|つく}る" is unnatural. Use "{冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}う" (to tell a joke) instead.
